title: Glycan recognition by a plant damage-sensing immune receptor
title_zh: 植物损伤感知免疫受体对糖链的识别
abstract: Pathogens target and degrade the extracellular matrix surrounding plant cells. A central question is how cell wall–derived damage-associated molecular patterns (DAMPs) are recognized and integrated to trigger immune responses. We address this question by determining the structure of the extracellular multidomain of the impaired in glycan perception 1 (IGP1) receptor in both apo form and bound to the cellulose-derived DAMP cellotriose. Structural analyses reveal that constitutive interactions of leucine-rich repeat (LRR)–malectin domains preconfigure IGP1 for ligand recognition and that the receptor features a highly specific sugar-binding pocket in the LRR domain capable of distinguishing fine variations in glycan structures. By directly sensing cello-oligomers, IGP1 operates as a cell wall surveillance receptor that links pathogen-induced wall degradation to immune alerting, equipping plants to mount rapid and robust defense responses.
abstract_zh: 病原体靶向并降解包围植物细胞的细胞外基质。核心问题是细胞壁衍生的损伤相关分子模式（DAMPs）如何被识别并整合以触发免疫反应。我们通过确定受体缺陷糖链感知1（IGP1）受体的胞外多域在空基态和与纤维素衍生的DAMP细胞三糖结合时的结构来探讨此问题。结构分析显示，富含亮氨酸重复（LRR）–马尔肯特域的持续相互作用预先为IGP1的配体识别做准备，并且该受体在LRR域中具有高度特异的糖结合口袋，能够区分糖链结构的细微差异。通过直接感知纤维素寡聚物，IGP1充当细胞壁监测受体，将病原体诱导的壁降解与免疫警报相连，赋予植物快速而强大的防御反应能力。
